request.system: You plan web searches. Given an entity extracted from a property graph, you write search queries that will find the real values of some of its missing properties. You never answer the questions yourself.

messages.content:
A Airport node was extracted from a property graph. These properties of the node and of related elements are known:
- Airport tz_database_timezone: Asia/Calcutta
- Airport country: India
- Airport name: Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi International Airport

Properties of this Airport to find:
- runwaysLength
- runwaysWidth
- commercial_flights

Write at most 3 web search queries that will find these values.
- Put identifying known values (name, code, city, country) in every query, so that the results are about this Airport and not another one.
- One query can target several properties when they are usually found on the same page.
- Every property to find must be targeted by at least one query.
- Do not guess or include any value of the properties to find.

Answer with only this JSON:
{"queries": [{"id": "q1", "query": "<search query>", "targets": ["<property to find>"]}]}
